A-hidden-title-measured.undoes: A — the title's shift is not measured while Preview hides the editor (it measured 0 there)

A-print-not-remeasured.undoes: A — the print function measures the title again on the shown, unselected sheet before copying it

A-preview-not-left.undoes: A — the print function leaves Preview, so the sheet it copies is shown and measured

C-selection-kept.undoes: C — the print function clears the selection before copying the sheet

C-pop-copied.undoes: C — a selection's pop still scaling a frame is ended before the copy

D-window-opened-late.undoes: D — the window is opened first, so a blocked one changes nothing else (Preview, the selection)

D-alert-changed.undoes: D — the popup-blocked alert is today's, word for word
edits: 'Popup blocked. Please allow popups for this site to use "Save PDF".',
'Popup blocked. Allow popups to use "Save PDF".',

D-no-shortcut.undoes: D — ⌘P / Ctrl+P calls the print function

D-topbar-dead.undoes: D — the top bar's Save PDF calls the print function

D-preview-own-print.undoes: D — Preview's Print / Save PDF is the print function itself (it used to leave Preview first and copy the sheet before it was shown)
edits:
// Preview and measures the shown sheet before it copies it.
        onPrint={printPoster}

D-key-any-modifier.undoes: D — ⌘P on a Mac, Ctrl+P elsewhere (Ctrl+P on a Mac is the system's caret key)

D-key-shift.undoes: D — Shift with it is the browser's (⇧⌘P)

D-key-alt.undoes: D — Alt with it is the browser's (⌥⌘P)

D-key-physical.undoes: D — the physical P key where the layout types a letter that is not Latin

D-key-latin-physical.undoes: D — a Latin letter is matched by itself, not by its physical key (Dvorak)

D-key-not-prevented.undoes: D — the browser's own print (of the editor page) is kept from running

D-key-repeat.undoes: D — a held key prints once

D-key-in-dialog.undoes: D — with a dialog open the key prints nothing

D-key-not-in-preview.undoes: D — the key prints from Preview too

D-key-composing.undoes: D — inside an input method's composition nothing prints

D-key-composing-default.undoes: D, review round 2 (R2-F3) — inside a composition the browser's own print of the editor page is kept away too (the key's default was left to run there)

D-key-stale-print.undoes: D — the key calls the print function of the poster as it is now, not of the first render (review round 1, R1-F1: a stale one printed a 48 × 36 in page for a 36 × 48 in poster)

D-key-closing-dialog.undoes: D — a dialog already answered (fading out, data-state="closing") does not hold the key (review round 1, R1-F6)

D-key-bubble.undoes: D — the key is caught at the window in the capture phase, before a handler on the page can stop it (review round 1, R1-F6)

B-no-sheet-base.undoes: B — the print restates the editor's base styles for the sheet

B-no-inherited-base.undoes: B — the sheet inherits the editor's line height of 1.5

B-table-rule.undoes: B — a table's borders collapse, as in the editor (preflight's table rule)

B-list-rule.undoes: B — lists inside blocks keep their bullets and indent (index.css)

B-zoom.undoes: B — the print scales the sheet with a transform, not CSS zoom (which laid it out again at 9.6 times the size)

E-no-color-adjust.undoes: E — print-color-adjust: exact keeps backgrounds without the dialog's Background graphics
